title: Scheduled maintenance Sunday 02:00–03:00
body: Haystax will be briefly unavailable on Sunday between 02:00 and 03:00 while we deploy an update. Thanks for your patience.

title: Reminder: keep vacancy updated
body: Owners, please update your available slots after each confirmation. Accurate vacancy helps tenants avoid unnecessary enquiries.

title: New review policy
body: You can now leave a review on any boarding you have viewed, not only after a confirmed tenancy.
